title: Apache HBase
scope: A production-oriented Apache HBase course covering the Bigtable-style data model, row-key and column-family design, regions and RegionServers, WAL/MemStore/HFiles, LSM compaction, block cache and Bloom filters, reads/writes/scans, consistency and durability, bulk loading, snapshots/backups, replication, security, coprocessors, APIs, observability, capacity planning, Hadoop/Spark integration, upgrades, and large-scale operations.
coverage_note: Apache HBase 2.6.x production line with awareness of the HBase 3.0 beta transition, Hadoop 3.x integration, Java 17-era deployment, synchronous/asynchronous APIs, replication, backup/snapshot tooling, and modern operational practice
